messages.text:
Hello HeliumDeploy Team,
 
I’m writing to ask for an update on my Harlo B30 miner order.
 
Could you please let me know when my unit is expected to be shipped and whether
there is an estimated shipping date?
 
I would also appreciate confirmation that my order is being processed as
scheduled.
 
Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to your reply.
 
Best regards,
Francesco C.
Used the store-orders skill
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Looked something up in Shopify
Used the store-orders skill
Read heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Hi Francesco,

I found your order, Shop···· from October 12. It's paid and on schedule. Your Harlo B30 ships November 30, 2026. The Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA is on the same order.

Your unit will ship from our warehouse in the Netherlands, so nothing is charged on delivery in Italy. That warehouse is waiting for its batch of B30s to arrive. You can follow that batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

We'll email you the tracking number when your B30 ships.

Best regards, Sarah

Good morning, I was supposed to receive a $70 bonus to purchase a product on
your website for attending the meeting to which I was invited, as well as
another $50 bonus for a previous meeting I attended; however, I have not
received either of these bonuses. Could you please send them to me as soon as
possible, so that I may place my order?
Used the chat-interview skill
Handed to the team · Interview thank-you credits aren't covered by my goodwill or code tools. He rais

Hi Francesco,

Thanks for your message, and I'm sorry you're still waiting on these. You raised the earlier one back in October and it should have been settled by now.

I've given the team both: the $70 for the interview you attended and the $50 for the earlier one. These thank-you credits are handled by a colleague, so I can't issue them myself. The team is offline today and picks this up tomorrow at 10am ET. They'll reply in this thread to confirm the credits and how to use them on your next order.

Best regards, Sarah

Hi Sarah, if you  give me the coupon code of 150$ i buy today the second unit of
harlo b30
Handed to the team · This is above my $50 code limit, and it depends on the $70 + $50 interview credi

Hi Francesco,

Thank you, it's good to hear you'd like a second B30.

A $150 code is more than I can issue myself. It's also tied to the $70 and $50 interview credits you're still waiting on, so it needs a colleague's decision. I've passed on your request for a single $150 code toward a second B30. The team picks it up today at 10am ET, and their answer will come to this email thread.

Best regards, Sarah
If you can get me the discount codes, I’ll order my second Harlo B30 today.

Hi Francesco,

Thanks for your patience. Your request is already with the team: the $70 and $50 interview credits, and your offer to order a second B30 today with a $150 code.

The team is online now and has your request in front of them. The answer will come to you in this thread. I can't promise the codes or the amount myself, as that's a colleague's decision. Once they reply, you'll have what you need to place the order.

Best regards, Sarah

Okay, I’m ready to place the order; as soon as you send me the coupon, I’ll go
ahead.

Hi Francesco,

Thanks, that's noted. The team has your request, and the coupon will come to you here in this thread once they've confirmed it. You don't need to do anything else in the meantime. When you have the code, enter it at checkout on your second B30.

Best regards, Sarah

Any news on my discount code? Why are you making me wait so long? It's 10 PM in
Italy. I'd like to go to sleep. If you send me the code, I'll place my order.

Hi Francesco,

I'm sorry. You've waited all day for this, and you should have had an answer by now.

I can't issue the $150 code myself, and I don't want to keep you up for something I can't send tonight. Your request is with the team: the $70 and $50 interview credits, and a $150 code for a second B30. The code will come to this email thread.

Please go to sleep. Nothing is lost by waiting, and you can place your order tomorrow once the code is in your inbox.

Best regards, Sarah
